root_cause_narrative: ContactHub moved /v2/contacts from offset to cursor pagination (contract drift). Our retry wrapper is non-idempotent: on a retry it rebuilds the page token from its own counter and re-sends the PREVIOUS page's cursor, so the retried page is fetched twice (duplicate-cursor fingerprint: GROUP BY cursor HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 on the 200s) and its successor page is silently skipped — the 350 missing contacts cluster exactly at those page boundaries. The 401s are a red herring: every one was retried successfully after a token refresh, so token expiry cannot explain the gap.
